product.name: PARTHVI Women's Pure Cotton Printed Straight Kurta Set with Palazzo Pants & Dupatta
product.product_type: Kurta Set with Palazzo Pants & Dupatta
product.description: A printed straight kurta set featuring a cotton kurta, cotton bottom and printed Mulmul dupatta, designed for traditional, casual, party and evening wear.

review_summary.summary: Customers generally like the kurta set's appearance, colors, comfort and value for money. Multiple reviews specifically praise its suitability for summer and the softness of the cotton fabric. However, several reviewers report that the fabric is very thin or feels cheap, while others mention sizing issues and color bleeding. There is also an isolated but serious complaint about receiving a damaged pant and missing dupatta.

review_summary.main_concern: The fabric is lightweight and summer-friendly, but some customers find it too thin or lower quality than expected.

fit.note: Several buyers report comfortable sizing, but some customers experienced imperfect fitting or unusual bottom/pant fitting.

summer_suitability.note: Multiple reviews explicitly describe the set as suitable or comfortable for summer. The thin fabric is a positive for heat but may be a concern for customers wanting heavier material.

value_for_money.note: Several reviews consider the product good or worthwhile for its price, although some customers feel the material quality does not justify higher prices.

color_fastness.note: Multiple reviews mention color bleeding or concerns about fading, particularly for some variants.

buying_advice.size_advice: Check the size chart before purchasing. While several buyers found the fit comfortable, some reviews report imperfect sizing or unusual bottom/pant fitting.
buying_advice.weather_advice: This is a strong option for summer and warm weather because multiple buyers describe it as comfortable and suitable for summer. However, the thin fabric may not suit customers who prefer more substantial material.
buying_advice.sales_advice: Lead with the floral design, cotton construction, lightweight feel, summer suitability and ₹749 price. Be transparent that some customers found the fabric very thin and that color bleeding and fit issues have been reported.

shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_product: Give a concise overview covering the floral style, cotton fabric, fit, 3/4 sleeves, V-neck, price, available colors and sizes, plus the main review insights.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_if_good: Recommend conditionally. Highlight the attractive design, cotton fabric, comfort, summer suitability and value, while mentioning that some buyers found the fabric very thin or lower quality.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_summer: Recommend it for summer. Multiple reviews specifically describe the outfit as comfortable or suitable for summer, although the thin fabric may be a concern for customers who prefer more coverage.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_fit: Explain that the set is designed with a straight kurta and relaxed-fit palazzo pants. Several buyers found the sizing comfortable, but some reported imperfect or unusual fitting, especially with the bottom.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_fabric: Explain that the listed fabrics are cotton for the kurta and bottom, with a Mulmul dupatta. Review feedback is mixed: many customers like the fabric, while some describe it as very thin or cheap.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_color: Mention that the product is available in multiple colors, but some reviews report color bleeding or concerns about fading.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_for_alternatives: Prioritize similar ethnic cotton or lightweight kurta sets with stronger fabric-quality and color-fastness signals if those attributes matter to the customer.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_for_best_product: Do not recommend this product solely because of its rating. Consider the customer's budget, summer/weather preference, desired fabric thickness, fit preference, occasion and tolerance for lightweight fabric.
